definitions.explanation: Fat stored in the body. Commonly discussed in health, fitness, and medical contexts, especially in relation to body fat percentage.

examples.japanese: {体脂肪|たいしぼう}を{減|へ}らす。
{体脂肪|たいしぼう}{率|りつ}を{毎月|まいつき}{測|はか}っている。
examples.english: I measure my body fat percentage every month.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}を{続|つづ}けたら、{体脂肪|たいしぼう}が{大|おお}きく{下|さ}がって{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}の{結果|けっか}もよくなった。
examples.english: After continuing to exercise, my body fat dropped significantly and my health checkup results improved too.

notes:
{体脂肪|たいしぼう} combines {体|たい} (body) + {脂肪|しぼう} (fat). Commonly discussed in health, fitness, and medical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体脂肪|たいしぼう}{率|りつ}: body fat percentage
- {体脂肪|たいしぼう}を{減|へ}らす: to reduce body fat
- {体脂肪|たいしぼう}を{落|お}とす: to drop body fat
- {体脂肪|たいしぼう}{計|けい}: body fat monitor/scale
- {体脂肪|たいしぼう}を{測|はか}る: to measure body fat

TYPES OF FAT:
- {内臓|ないぞう}{脂肪|しぼう}: visceral fat (around organs — health risk)
- {皮下|ひか}{脂肪|しぼう}: subcutaneous fat (under the skin)

RELATED WORDS:
- {脂肪|しぼう}: fat (general term)
- {体重|たいじゅう}: body weight
- BMI: body mass index (used as-is in Japanese)
